cover.title: 5 niche things that will make you terrifyingly good at growth without cookies

inner.title: a quarter say no
inner.body: iab europe figures put cookie acceptance at about 54% of europeans, with 26% denying. your dashboard treats that missing quarter as if it never visited.

inner.title: the cnil exemption
inner.body: cnil lets analytics skip consent if it only measures audience, truncates ip and caps trackers at 13 months. it warns most large tools don't qualify.

inner.title: tag campaigns, not people
inner.body: edpb guidelines from 7 october 2024 treat tracking links carrying identifiers like pixels. a per-person id in a link is a tracker, not a utm tag.

inner.title: the reject button
inner.body: the edpb's 2023 cookie taskforce says most regulators want reject all on the first layer. making refusal harder than accepting, even by colour, gets flagged.

inner.title: €475m in fines
inner.body: cnil sanctioned 21 entities over trackers in 2025, including fines of €325 million and €150 million. ignoring a refusal was on the list too.

better counting.
